test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (NOTE: All numbers are single digit numbers only.)

(Left) 1$@% 143*#634£%2@6% 8% 9 $ (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 1$@% 143*#634£%2@6% 8% 9 $ (Right)

According to the question, 

Required condition: Symbol - Number - Symbol

(Left) 1$@% 143*#634£__**%2@6% 8% 9 $**__ (Right)

Thus, there are four such numbers which are immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
